title: Decision Table: Connection Tenure Points on a Reinstated Security Deposits Installment
content:
Tenure points are earned toward the first installment of a Security Deposits deposit reinstated on the waiver reinstatement basis while its service account waits to be reconnected. They come from the whole months from the account's connect date to today, the connect date being the one shown on the Electric Service by Rate Schedule account the reinstated deposit secures.

## Rule

An account connected at least the long-tenure months of **36** earns the long-tenure points of **5**; an account connected at least the mid-tenure months of **12** but fewer than 36 earns the mid-tenure points of **2**; an account connected fewer than 12 months earns no tenure points. Tenure points count as relief points, which are taken off the first-installment share in percentage points, never off the amount.

## Decision table

| Whole months from the connect date to today | Tenure points |
|---|---|
| 36 or more | 5 |
| 12 to 35 | 2 |
| 0 to 11 | none |

## Edges of each band

| Whole months connected | Tenure points |
|---|---|
| 36 | 5 |
| 35 | 2 |
| 12 | 2 |
| 11 | none |

Only completed months count: an account 35 whole months and some days past its connect date is in the 12 to 35 band.
